sections.heading: What Is Low-E Glass and Why Does It Matter for Arlington Properties?
sections.body: Low-emissivity, or Low-E, glass is manufactured with an ultra-thin metallic coating that reflects infrared and ultraviolet light while allowing visible light to pass through. This technology helps regulate interior temperatures by reducing heat gain in summer and limiting heat loss in winter. For properties in Arlington — where seasonal temperatures swing from humid, hot summers to cold winters — this kind of thermal performance can make interior spaces noticeably more comfortable year-round. Commercial property managers overseeing office buildings near Crystal City and homeowners in neighborhoods like Lyon Village increasingly choose Low-E glass as a practical upgrade when replacing aging windows or glass storefronts. The coating also helps reduce UV-related fading of furniture, flooring, and merchandise, which is a meaningful benefit for retail tenants and residential clients alike. Our team walks every client through the available Low-E glass options so you can make an informed decision based on your building's orientation, existing framing, and performance goals.

sections.heading: Low-E Glass Options: Choosing the Right Product for Your Arlington Project
sections.body: Not all Low-E glass is the same, and selecting the right product depends on factors like building orientation, climate zone, existing HVAC capacity, and aesthetic preferences. Low-E coatings are available in hard-coat and soft-coat varieties, each with different performance characteristics and installation considerations. Dual-pane and triple-pane insulated glass units incorporating Low-E coatings offer varying levels of thermal insulation. For Arlington's mixed climate, many commercial and residential clients benefit from a balanced Low-E product that addresses both solar heat gain during summer and heat retention during colder months. Our glazing specialists help you evaluate the options without overwhelming technical jargon, providing straightforward guidance so you select a product that fits your project and your budget.
